description: Identifier of the Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolate as used in the supplement: the sampling site letter (A to G), the water sample number at that site (1 to 3) and the colony letter (a to d), for example A1a.

Sampling site along the Buriganga River, coded A to G as in the supplement. The article describes seven sites that differ in their point source of pollution (industrial, medical waste and municipal waste discharges among them); the supplement does not name them.
Short code of the antibiotic disc as used in the supplement: PIT, CTX, CPM, GEN, AK, MRP, IPM, TE or CIP.
Name of the antibiotic.
Class of the antibiotic: Penicillins, Cephalosporins, Aminoglycosides, Carbapenems, Tetracyclines or Fluoroquinolones.
Amount of antibiotic on the disc used in the Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion test, in micrograms, as given in the supplement (100/10 µg for piperacillin-tazobactam).

Diameter of the zone of inhibition around the disc in millimetres, from supplementary table S3. NA where the supplement shows a dash, which means no zone of inhibition was recorded; every such test is interpreted as resistant.
Interpretation of the zone diameter against the breakpoints in burigangaamr_antibiotics, as given in supplementary table S4: susceptible, intermediate or resistant.
